data.revised_prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality desktop SaaS admin UI redesign mockup for a Chinese private-domain community management system, landscape composition 1440x1024. Use the attached current product screenshot as the primary visual reference and preserve its brand language exactly: white and very light gray surfaces, black text and controls, vivid acid-lime #CCFF00 accents, compact monochrome iconography, restrained 6-8px radii, quiet utilitarian operations-tool character, left navigation and top utility bar.

Concept: Status-first community dashboard. Active page title is “微信群管理”. Keep the existing left sidebar structure and top utility bar feel. In the content area, use a narrow top title/action band and a segmented status control with tabs: 全部, 健康, 接近满员, 群码待更新, 待分配. Below that place a wide unframed operational summary strip with key numbers and a compact horizontal capacity distribution visualization — it should feel like a live operations summary, not decorative cards. Main content is a dense production table with realistic Chinese data and columns: 群名称, 归属区域/微信, 负责人, 群类型, 成员容量, 群码有效期, 最近活跃, actions. Group rows into subtle status sections using very light separators and restrained lime/yellow/red badges.

Add a right-side slim contextual alert rail within the page surface, aligned to the content area, showing three urgent items such as 群码即将失效, 容量超过90%, and 待分配群码. Include compact icon buttons and restrained lime/red/yellow status accents. Include filters for region and manager above the table. No cards inside cards, no large hero, no gradients, no purple, no browser chrome, no tutorial copy. Ensure text is crisp, readable, and fits realistically in the layout. The page should look like a real enterprise SaaS redesign screenshot, not an illustration. Maintain the left nav items and the general app framing from the reference screenshot, but improve visual hierarchy and density in a modern clean way.
